summary: Join our expert-led training course on data security and privacy in geospatial systems. Learn essential strategies to safeguard your data today.
lede: Geospatial security and privacy training helps GIS analysts, spatial database administrators, privacy officers, and geospatial managers protect location data. Participants practise inventorying data assets, setting access controls, modelling threats, assessing re-identification risk, and choosing geomasking methods for data release decisions. They also review platform and API safeguards and prepare incident-response workflows and governance roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who govern, operate, secure, publish, analyse, or procure geospatial data and services. It suits intermediate practitioners who can work with GIS concepts and organizational security processes but need a structured approach to location-data protection.
modules: Spatial Threat Modelling and Risk Analysis
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of GIS concepts, spatial data formats, map services, or geospatial databases, plus basic familiarity with organizational information security or privacy processes. No programming is required for completion. PostGIS, GeoServer, API security, differential privacy, and AI-assisted geospatial analysis are taught at operational application or conceptual awareness level, not production engineering level. Bring a laptop for digital templates and lab exercises. Practical labs use provided datasets and browser-accessible or instructor-prepared environments, subject to delivery arrangements.
